codeReview.summary: The visual restyling hits the requested pill/card/progress-bar patterns, but the feature regresses analytics correctness and localization. The new summary cards show fabricated trend numbers, the category breakdown is built from a truncated recent-activity sample instead of the real filtered analytics data, and the newly added labels were not wired into the locale files.

issues.description: The redesign hardcodes trend outputs (e.g. `12% vs last season`, `8%`, `3%`) in the new summary cards instead of deriving them from analytics data. That introduces fabricated numbers into an analytics screen, which violates the requirement to preserve existing data/analytics behavior. Evidence: app/analytics.tsx:193-200, 227-229, 255-260.

The new 'Activities Logged' stat and category breakdown are computed from `analytics.recentActivity`, but that source is only the latest 10 irrigation/spray/harvest items and omits expenses/fertigation entirely. As a result, the redesigned counts/bars underreport the selected time range and can never reflect all categories accurately. Evidence: app/analytics.tsx:250, 294, 301-315; src/services/analytics-service.ts:396-435.

The feature introduced new analytics labels without adding locale entries, and also hardcoded several English strings directly in the screen. `analytics.labels.totalExpenses`, `analytics.labels.harvestYield`, `analytics.labels.activitiesLogged`, and `analytics.sections.categoryBreakdown` do not exist in the locale files, so the UI will render raw translation keys; additional strings like `tons`, `entries`, `Irrigation`, and `vs last season` bypass i18n entirely. Evidence: app/analytics.tsx:182, 199, 217, 224, 246, 291, 294, 312-315; src/i18n/locales/en.ts:783-812 (same gap in hi.ts:784-813 and mr.ts:785-814).
